$comment: Licence policy for scripts/check-licenses.mjs. See docs/licensing.md. A package fails the check when its declared licence expression is strong copyleft (GPL, AGPL, CC-BY-SA...), non-commercial, unknown, or weak copyleft other than the licences in allowedWeakCopyleft (so LGPL needs an exception), unless it has an exception here. `overrides` correct package metadata that is missing or wrong; every override cites the page it was verified on, and an override with a `version` applies to that exact version only so a new release is re-checked. `exceptions` accept a risk and must say why it does not reach users; they can be limited to lockfiles or requirements files with `scope`.

overrides.name: dotenv
overrides.evidence: https://pypi.org/pypi/dotenv/0.9.9/json (a shim that only depends on python-dotenv; repository pedroburon/dotenv carries an MIT LICENSE). PyPI metadata says UNKNOWN.

overrides.name: stop-sequencer
overrides.evidence: https://github.com/hyunwoongko/stop-sequencer README states Apache-2.0; the repository has no LICENSE file and the sdist has no licence metadata, so this is UNVERIFIED as a formal grant. Benchmark-only, not shipped.

overrides.name: pypdfium2
overrides.evidence: https://github.com/pypdfium2-team/pypdfium2 (README, Licensing: Apache-2.0 or BSD-3-Clause, with the PDFium binary and its BUILD_LICENSES). PyPI metadata lists 'BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, dependency licenses', which is not a valid expression.

overrides.name: langdetect
overrides.evidence: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mimino666/langdetect/master/NOTICE and LICENSE are Apache-2.0; setup.py says MIT, the classifier says Apache.

exceptions.name: html2text
exceptions.reason: GPL-3.0-or-later (https://pypi.org/pypi/html2text/2025.4.15/json). Pulled in by bfcl-eval for the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard run. Benchmark tooling that runs on a developer machine; it is never imported by, bundled with or distributed alongside the application or its sidecars.

exceptions.name: chardet
exceptions.reason: chardet 6.0.0.post1 is LGPL-2.1-or-later (https://pypi.org/pypi/chardet/6.0.0.post1/json). It is pulled in by lm-eval through pytablewriter and mbstrdecoder (which pins chardet<7). Benchmark tooling that runs on a developer machine; never imported by, bundled with or distributed alongside the application or its sidecars.

NVIDIA CUDA runtime wheels (LicenseRef-NVIDIA-Proprietary, or no licence field for the cuda-toolkit meta package) that pip resolves for torch on Linux when sentence-transformers or bfcl-eval is installed. Benchmark and embedding-evaluation tooling that runs on a developer machine; these wheels are never imported by, bundled with or distributed alongside the application or its sidecars, and are not in any other requirements file.

exceptions.name: cuda-toolkit
